title: AI-Powered Browsers Are Broadly Accurate News Summarizers That Reduce Political Bias and Negative Affect

bias_targets.methodology: Using a Large Language Model (GPT-5.2) to annotate source news articles and AI-generated summaries on ordinal scales for ideological bias (from far left to far right) and partisan stances (favorability toward Democrats and Republicans), followed by statistical modeling to evaluate whether the summarizers attenuate or introduce bias.
